'''Magical Pokémon Journey: Eevee-Lu-tion''' is the twenty-first monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]]. It contains the 31st and 32nd chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of {{Vol|Magical Pokémon Journey|6}}. As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
==Blurb==
'''''FIRST LOVE'''''

''Eevee has a major crush on another Eevee, but the target of its affection is way too shy to introduce itself. Can Hazel and Coconut make love bloom between the two Eevee?'' 

''Then, Ditto is good at mimicking Pokémon, but can it do a human?''
